## MoodMate: Emotion Classification Using NLP

**Tools:** Python, scikit-learn, pandas, NLTK, TF-IDF  
**Type:** Collaborative Machine Learning Project

Collaborated on the development of a natural language processing (NLP) pipeline to classify written text into six emotions: sadness, joy, love, anger, fear, and surprise.

### Methodology

- **Data Preprocessing:** Cleaned and prepared text data for machine learning.
- **Feature Engineering:** Applied text vectorization techniques, including TF-IDF and CountVectorizer.
- **Model Development:** Trained and compared Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Random Forest classifiers.
- **Evaluation:** Assessed model performance using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.

### Model Performance

| Model | Validation Accuracy |
|---|---:|
| Logistic Regression | 87.45% |
| Naive Bayes | 68.10% |
| Random Forest | **89.85%** |

Random Forest achieved the highest validation accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of ensemble learning for this multiclass text classification task.

### Key Takeaways

This project strengthened our experience with natural language processing, text feature extraction, supervised machine learning, and comparative model evaluation.
